test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Desiderate
solution:
The correct answer is Disregard.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word 'Desiderate' is 'Disregard'.
 
• Desiderate: feel a keen desire for.
 
• Meaning of the given options:
 
 
• Quarrel*: *an angry argument or disagreement
 
• *Disregard: to take no notice of somebody/something; to treat something as unimportant*
 
• Acquire: to obtain or buy something
 
• Mandate: the power that is officially given to a group of people to do something, especially after they have won an election
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 2.​
